s1.lead: Meet da Tribu is the guide older students wish they had been given. Everything you need to make your first weeks at HEI count.

mission.title: The mission.
mission.text: AI, cyber and code, for jobs in Madagascar.

domains.title: Three fields.
domains.text: Cloud and cybersecurity, AI, software engineering.

s3.desc: Everyone starts with programming fundamentals, in Java and JavaScript. Then two paths: Software Ecosystem to build robust, secure applications, and Digital Transformation to make data work for businesses.

s4.desc: Every theoretical concept comes with a hands-on project. After three years in the LMD system: a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science recognised by MESupRES.

cloud.imageAlt: Hundreds of HEI students dancing together in the courtyard during the 2024 welcome week

reperes.imageAlt: The HEI building in Ivandry, with its courtyard and white walkways

s1.title: Find the campus before day one.
s1.desc: II J 161 R, Ambodivoanjo, Ivandry. The front desk is open Monday to Friday, 8am-12pm and 1pm-4pm.

s2.title: On day one, it all starts at the front desk.
s2.desc: Arrive early, introduce yourself, save your classmates' contacts. Now is the time for the "silly" questions.

s3.title: The LEI sets your foundations in two weeks.
s3.desc: L'École d'Informatique, mandatory for every first-year: the tools, HTML/CSS, and your class. The final project: your own survival guide.

s4.title: The intranet runs your days.
s4.desc: Classes, rooms, announcements: everything goes through the intranet and Google Workspace. Make checking it a morning habit.

w1.hint: UNDERSTAND THE PROBLEM BEFORE WRITING A LINE

w2.hint: PRACTISE EVERY DAY, IN PROJECTS AND IN TEAMS

w3.hint: CHANGE THINGS, IN MADAGASCAR AND BEYOND

manifesto.kicker: GOOD ADVICE · WHAT I WISH I HAD KNOWN
manifesto.text: Nobody is waiting for you to fail. Ask early, pair up, and [[ask for help]] before you get lost. That's what the Tribe is for.

testimonial.label: A graduate's testimony
testimonial.quote: I landed my first job during my internship. In interviews, I had code to show: all my HEI projects.
testimonial.author: [First name L.], Mpamakilay class
testimonial.context: OF THE CLASS IN A JOB, 10 MONTHS AFTER GRADUATION
